reviews.t: Definitely recommend. Buy here & save yourself some money!
reviews.x: This whitening treatment is amazing. I have super sensitive teeth & have tried many over the counter options but could not continue through the whole treatment series due to sensitivity issues. The first time I completed 10 trays as recommended by my dentist. I purchased that first package from them for $89.99 (toothpaste not included in their price). On the 3rd tray I had some sensitivity & preservered thru it as recommended for optimal whitening. No sensitivity noted with all following treatme

reviews.t: Ultradent only sells to licensed dentists, so these products ...
reviews.x: Ultradent only sells to licensed dentists, so these products being sold online have unknown sources. These items are not supposed to be sold directly to consumer for safety reasons.  Here is a written statement I received from Ultradent: "Ultradent only sells its Opalescence products directly to dental professionals in the United States." ... "Thus, while it may appear that these third parties are selling the products for a lower price, the item you actually receive may not include t

My dentist believes this kit is a knock-off because it is supposed to be sold EXCLUSIVELY to dental professionals (who then re-sell it to their patients). I paid my dentist $80.00 for my first kit, which was only 10% hydrogen peroxide. To get 15% AND the whitening toothpaste for $52.00 is a great deal. Best of all, it was very effective.

reviews.t: Great product. It works and yes it's strong
reviews.x: Great product. It works and yes it's strong, so if you want to protect your gums from being burned use some vaseline. Apply with a Q-tip before using the first tray, by the 2nd application you will start feeling some sensitivity. If you ask me, I think it is worth it. I really don't want to spend $300 at the dentist when I can do this at home for $60. Same product that my dentist offered.

reviews.t: Try it out, but with a grain of salt
reviews.x: So, I ordered this product and did receive it in a timely manner. I’m currently on the last packet of it and I have to say, it’s okay. What I mean by okay is it’s packaged well and seems legitimate but, it didn’t get shipped cold and it literally says on the box to keep it refrigerated. Also, I’ve been consistently using the packs.. one every other day and leaving it on for 25-30 minutes, but it hasn’t noticeably whitened my teeth. Maybe it’s a placebo effect to see a “huge difference” but I hon

I have been using the Opalescent Go Teeth Whitening trays and toothpaste for 10 days. (amount of trays in pack) I immediately felt like my teeth were cleaner than regular tooth paste. By the third day using the duo I was really impressed. I have not had teeth feeling so clean with out visiting the dental hygienist.  It is a nice change from typical toothpaste and whitening mouthwash to wake up in the morning and not experience what my family calls dragon breath. I'm not saying I was all minty fr

reviews.t: Purchase through your dentist. Better quality.
reviews.x: I purchased a box of this directly from my dentist. Those worked well as far as applying to my teeth, with great results.  The box purchased through Amazon is either defective or dated. Just difficult for the mold to adhere to my teeth, it often cracks and separates after about 10 minutes. I wonder if these are seconds  or dated.

reviews.t: This product burnt the hell out of my gums. ...
reviews.x: This product burnt the hell out of my gums. I thought it was just a fluke and maybe it was just me and my gums were sensitive then my wife started to use the second one that we bought and it burnt her gums too! In my opinion if you are trying to whiten your teeth just go to a dentist and have ti done.

reviews.t: My teeth were much whiter after 6 treatments, but afterwards the other 4 didn't do much.
reviews.x: I have never whitened my teeth in my life, so I decided to give it a try.  After the first 6 treatments of Opalescence GO, my teeth were much whiter than before, but the last 4 treatments of the 10 that come in the box didn't make much difference anymore, so if I do it again in the future, I think maybe I'll just do 5 or 6 and save the rest for a later date.  Another thing that I'd like to add, is that in the videos on YouTube show people easily putting the plastic applicator in their mouth and

The trays work well if you read the instructions on proper way to apply.  I had a temporary bridge and wanted to whiten my natural teeth before permanent teeth were placed.  My natural teeth whitened several shades lighter and my bridge which was matched to my natural teeth.  The color difference was shocking after 3 applications.  My bridge looked terrible. My bridge was changed out to match my improved white natural color.  I am incredibly excited about the product.  It is a great product.  If

reviews.t: I finally have a bright smile!
reviews.x: This is my second time using opalescence. I got the first kit from my dentist and was really impressed with the results. After using all the whitening toothpastes and other over the counter treatments, I found with this, I finally had white teeth! During the treatment, I did get some teeth burn; it’s powerful stuff! But using a sensitive toothpaste helped leave he ate that. Plus I didn’t mind so much that it hurt because I knew it was working. The whitening agent really gets deep into the enamel
I like how quickly it whitens my teeth. So effortless!

I am very dissapointed with the toothpaste itself. I have to use it with a combination of something else, like sensodyne. Sensodyne foams up easily and allows me to brush for 2 minutes, but this paste turns liquid and after 30 seconds, it's as if I am brushing with water. Very dissapointed, with the price and the overall quality.
Only whitened them a little. Not much better than Crest Whitestrips. Won't purchase again.

This cannot be the real thing. I got two trays from my dentist a year ago to try and loved it.  I decided to just order it here because quarantine lol. These didn’t work...AT ALL. I had to take a couple days break in between because it burned the heck out of my gums. But I was expecting that. I took my comparison pic at the same time of day, same place. The pic on the left is actually the AFTER pic...which imo looks worse than the before pic. How does that even happen?! LOL  Sad that I lost $80

I used (1) of my 10.  I am typically decent with pain and do not complain.  This product hurt my teeth so bad! I have never had sensitive teeth.  I would be ok if after the pain lasted an hour or so........ My teeth were still hurting so bad hours later. I just could not believe it was still hurting many hours later. Now I am stuck with an expensive whitener I cannot use.. Any suggestions offered as to how maybe I can build-up  my teeth prior to trying this again??

The product arrived on an extremely hot day in just a cardboard box yet the package label said it must be refrigerated!  But to use the product, a whitening tray is supposed to be at room temperature.  The gel doesn’t seem to dissolve very well but my teeth are whiter. Did increase tooth sensitivity so I can’t use it daily for the 10 days.

I use 20% once every few weeks. When I get lazy and skip a month or 2, I reach for my 35% - 2 or 3 days in a row.  When I  really need an instant boost, one or 2 treatment of 45% easily does it. It's best to invest in bleaching trays. They last forever. Opalescent is what we use and recommend in a dental office.  It is what works.
So far so good did see a difference first use. No burning to my gum like other people say on their reviews and my gum are extremely sensitive.

I was going to take him to that kiosk in the mall which costs $100 but since this is cheaper and leaves you with the toothpaste for later use, I figure why not.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the product effective at whitening teeth, often comparing it favorably to dentist-purchased kits or over-the-counter options.
Several reviewers report gum burning or sensitivity during use, though some consider it worth it or manageable with precautions like vaseline.
Some reviewers question the product's authenticity or sourcing, noting it is supposed to be sold only through licensed dentists and suspecting online versions are knock-offs or defective.
A few reviewers report disappointing or minimal results, especially compared to dentist versions or other brands.
Some reviewers note the whitening effect plateaus after the first several treatments, with later trays making little difference.
